name: FirstUse
title: Templates/Platform/States/FirstUse
summary: The block a first-level list renders before the account owns any resource of that kind: a flush CardBox holding an EmptyState (the resource glyph, headline, lead and a Documentation link) over an Item.List of the ways to create the first one, each led by a bordered icon frame, with the promo cards below it: Catalog templates (only for resource kinds that have a template catalog) and agent onboarding, whose frames carry the Claude, Codex, Gemini and Cursor marks from the webkit assets. The EmptyState’s icon slot shows the resource glyph; an app may draw a richer figure there. Every list that is still empty renders it with its own nouns, methods and promos. Built from CardBox, EmptyState, Item, Button, InputGroup, InputText, CopyButton and Link.
